name: RC–B10–0156/2025 – Before § 1 – Am 14
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing the unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after three years of Russia’s war of aggression
part_text: 1a. Calls, after 11 years of war in Ukraine, for a just and lasting peace, which requires taking into account the causes of the conflict and putting an end to the strategy of instigating and prolonging the war;
